# @carlosnc/tmdb-sdk

> A lightweight, fully-typed TypeScript client for The Movie Database (TMDB) API v3/v4 with zero runtime dependencies.

## Overview

- **Runtime**: Works in Node.js >= 18, Bun, Deno, Cloudflare Workers, and browser environments.
- **Dependencies**: 0 external runtime dependencies (uses native `fetch`).
- **Typing**: 100% TypeScript with strict interfaces and autocompletion.
- **Authentication**: Supports v3 API Key, v3 Bearer Token, and v4 User Access Tokens.
- **Resilience**: Optional automatic retry with exponential backoff on rate limits (429) and server errors (5xx).
- **Framework Adapters**: Built-in proxy adapters for SvelteKit and Next.js App Router to keep API keys secure server-side.

## Installation

```bash
bun add @carlosnc/tmdb-sdk
# or
npm install @carlosnc/tmdb-sdk
# or
pnpm add @carlosnc/tmdb-sdk
```

## Quick Start

```typescript
import { TMDBClient } from "@carlosnc/tmdb-sdk";

// Initialize client (API Read Access Token preferred)
const tmdb = new TMDBClient({
  accessToken: process.env.TMDB_ACCESS_TOKEN,
  // Or fallback to API key:
  // apiKey: process.env.TMDB_API_KEY,
  defaultLanguage: "en-US",
  retry: true, // Auto retry on 429 and 5xx
});

// Search movies
const searchResults = await tmdb.search.movies({ query: "Inception" });

// Get movie details with appended resources
const movie = await tmdb.movie.getDetails(27205, {
  appendToResponse: ["credits", "videos", "images", "recommendations"],
});

console.log(movie.title, movie.vote_average);
```

## Client Configuration

```typescript
interface TMDBClientConfig {
  accessToken?: string;        // TMDB v3/v4 API Read Access Token (Bearer)
  apiKey?: string;             // TMDB v3 API Key (query parameter fallback)
  defaultLanguage?: string;    // Global default language (e.g. 'en-US', 'pt-BR')
  retry?: boolean | RetryConfig; // Automatic exponential backoff
  httpClient?: HttpClient;     // Custom HTTP client implementing HttpClient interface
  omdbApiKey?: string;         // Optional OMDb API key for awards enrichment
}
```

## Namespaces & Core Methods

### Movies (`tmdb.movie`)
- `getDetails(id, params?)`: Details, optionally with `appendToResponse` and `includeAwards: true`
- `getNowPlaying(params?)`, `getPopular(params?)`, `getTopRated(params?)`, `getUpcoming(params?)`
- `getCredits(id)`, `getVideos(id)`, `getImages(id)`, `getRecommendations(id)`, `getSimilar(id)`
- `getWatchProviders(id)`, `getReleaseDates(id)`, `getTranslations(id)`
- `addRating(id, rating, session?)`, `deleteRating(id, session?)`

### TV Shows (`tmdb.tv`)
- `getDetails(id, params?)`: Series details with `appendToResponse`
- `getAiringToday(params?)`, `getOnTheAir(params?)`, `getPopular(params?)`, `getTopRated(params?)`
- `getCredits(id)`, `getAggregateCredits(id)`, `getSeason(id, seasonNumber)`

### TV Seasons & Episodes (`tmdb.tvSeason`, `tmdb.tvEpisode`)
- `tvSeason.getDetails(tvId, seasonNumber, params?)`
- `tvEpisode.getDetails(tvId, seasonNumber, episodeNumber, params?)`

### Search (`tmdb.search`)
- `search.movies({ query, page?, year?, includeAdult? })`
- `search.tv({ query, page?, firstAirDateYear? })`
- `search.people({ query, page? })`
- `search.multi({ query, page? })`
- `search.collections({ query, page? })`
- `search.companies({ query, page? })`
- `search.keywords({ query, page? })`

### Trending & Discover (`tmdb.trending`, `tmdb.discover`)
- `trending.getTrending(mediaType, timeWindow, params?)`: mediaType: `'all' | 'movie' | 'tv' | 'person'`; timeWindow: `'day' | 'week'`
- `discover.movies({ sortBy?, withGenres?, primaryReleaseYear?, voteAverageGte?, ... })`
- `discover.tv({ sortBy?, withGenres?, firstAirDateYear?, ... })`

### People (`tmdb.person`)
- `getDetails(id, params?)`: Biography, birth date, place of birth
- `getMovieCredits(id)`, `getTvCredits(id)`, `getCombinedCredits(id)`, `getImages(id)`

### Genres & Configuration (`tmdb.genre`, `tmdb.configuration`)
- `genre.getMovieList({ language? })`, `genre.getTvList({ language? })`
- `configuration.getApiConfiguration()`: Returns secure base URLs and sizes for images
- `configuration.getLanguages()`, `configuration.getCountries()`

### Watch Providers (`tmdb.watchProviders`)
- `getAvailableRegions()`
- `getMovieProviders({ watchRegion? })`, `getTvProviders({ watchRegion? })`

## Helper Utilities

### Image URLs
```typescript
import { getImageUrl } from "@carlosnc/tmdb-sdk";

// Poster URL
const posterUrl = getImageUrl("/qJ2tW6WMUDux911r6m7haRef0WH.jpg", "w500");

// Original resolution
const backdropUrl = getImageUrl("/path.jpg", "original");
```

### Auto Pagination
```typescript
import { paginate } from "@carlosnc/tmdb-sdk";

const allPages = await paginate(
  (page) => tmdb.movie.getPopular({ page }),
  { maxPages: 3 }
);
```

## Error Handling

All API errors throw specialized subclasses of `TMDBError`:

```typescript
import {
  TMDBError,
  TMDBUnauthorizedError,
  TMDBNotFoundError,
  TMDBRateLimitError,
  TMDBValidationError
} from "@carlosnc/tmdb-sdk";

try {
  await tmdb.movie.getDetails(99999999);
} catch (error) {
  if (error instanceof TMDBNotFoundError) {
    console.error("Movie not found");
  } else if (error instanceof TMDBRateLimitError) {
    console.error(`Rate limited. Retry after ${error.retryAfter}s`);
  } else if (error instanceof TMDBUnauthorizedError) {
    console.error("Invalid token or API key");
  } else if (error instanceof TMDBError) {
    console.error(`TMDB error (${error.statusCode}): ${error.message}`);
  }
}
```

## Framework Adapters (Zero-Exposure API Keys)

### Next.js (App Router)
```typescript
// app/api/tmdb/[...path]/route.ts
import { createNextJsHandler } from "@carlosnc/tmdb-sdk/nextjs";

export const { GET, POST, DELETE } = createNextJsHandler({
  accessToken: process.env.TMDB_ACCESS_TOKEN!,
});
```

### SvelteKit
```typescript
// src/routes/api/tmdb/[...path]/+server.ts
import { createSvelteKitHandler } from "@carlosnc/tmdb-sdk/sveltekit";

export const { GET, POST, DELETE } = createSvelteKitHandler({
  accessToken: process.env.TMDB_ACCESS_TOKEN!,
});
```
